items.title: Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model
items.blurb: Claude Code burns ~15-20% of your tokens on a 3-word status line: a Bun preload that turns agent_summary off · by Flamerix AI, flamerix.ai · MIT - README.md

items.title: Anthropic Says Nobody Needs a Mental Model of Claude Code. Practitioners Are Testing That
items.blurb: Anthropic has published how the Claude Code team reviews code now that Claude writes roughly 90% of it, including a claim that nobody keeps a complete mental model of the codebase.

items.title: Pair-coding Lobste.rs feat
items.blurb: There is a long standing issue I'm working at that turned out to have some interesting refactoring suggested by the admins . Does anybody want to pair-code this feat with me? (I also mentioned it in irc).

items.title: Datadog Builds a Specialist AI Model for SRE Investigations
items.blurb: Datadog has released Scout, a model trained to investigate production problems. It runs inside Bits Investigation, the company's AI SRE product, where it can pick up an alert, look through telemetry and suggest what caused the problem.

items.title: Cloudflare Introduces Web Search API for AI Applications
items.blurb: Cloudflare has recently launched a beta Web Search API through AI Gateway. Available through REST APIs and Cloudflare Workers, it provides unified logging, access controls, and billing, and supports bring-your-own-provider keys.

items.title: Airbnb Cuts Recommendation Staleness from 2 Days to Seconds with Chronon
items.blurb: Airbnb extended its Chronon feature platform with Push Mode and Near Real-Time Model Transform to update sequence-based recommendation embeddings within seconds.

items.title: Dayjob: Tax – evaluating AI agents on 50 professional tax assignments
items.blurb: DAYJOB: Tax evaluates AI agents across 50 realistic tax environments, testing their ability to navigate messy records, exercise professional judgment, and deliver reliable tax work.

items.title: Kentucky man becomes the first humanist granted religious exemption from AI
How to Make Artificial Intelligence More Environmentally Sustainable
items.blurb: IT is responsible for about 2 - 4% of all global emissions, and electricity use at Microsoft and Google has climbed because of AI, according to their own reports. Sustainability ought to be a top-level architectural concern.

items.title: QCon AI New York 2026 Program Committee Picks: Agent Identity, Context Costs, and Open-Source Infere
items.blurb: Who authorizes an agent’s actions, and how should teams manage growing context costs?

items.title: The future is Postgres
items.blurb: Craig Kerstiens returns to talk about the ever-expanding world of Postgres: a deliberately boring core, a thriving extension ecosystem, and pg_lake bringing DuckDB and Iceberg into the mix.
